lines.spoken: Useful work can be free, without leaving its creator unpaid.
Like a workshop kit that helps a community learn together.
Sunset lets people sponsor its public release.
Meet the target, and publish the matching key on time.
The creator can then claim payment.
If those conditions are missed, sponsors can claim refunds.
People keep a copy, use it, and share it. Even offline.
That core flow has already been verified on testnet.
So creators can make the next free thing possible.
